gemini.rationale: The slice documents the post-deal trajectory of OneBeacon under Intact, noting premium growth, a combined ratio of 94.9%, and the exit of the Healthcare product line. There is no documented evidence of product/process incoherence (p4) or process/organization fracture (p5) causing disruption over time.
